name: engine-pin-recorded
body: Every frontend container states its engine pin with an exact version and the language-version ceiling that pin imposes. Where the ceiling is the user's installed toolchain rather than the pin alone (Go, Java, Rust), the container says so jointly. A frontend container that records no engine pin is a violation. The four pre-existing containers (go/java/ts/py) have been brought up to this contract; C++'s vendored tree-sitter/tree-sitter-cpp grammar version is still unrecorded and must be recorded.
